javascript-es6.name: JavaScript ES6
javascript-es6.description: The ECMAScript 6 (ES2015) standard was ratified in 2015 following years of work standardizing improvements to ECMAScript 3. The committee introduced a wide variety of improvements such as arrow functions, const declarations, and native Promises.
